question: how many laptops is aims cameroon procuring for students
answer: 60 high-performance, 14-inch laptops, new or professionally refurbished, with a 36-month hardware warranty.
evidence: AIMS Cameroon is inviting qualified vendors and oems to bid for the supply, delivery and commissioning of sixty (60) high-performance laptops.

question: how is the student laptop tender scored
answer: 40% technical compliance, 25% total cost of ownership, 15% warranty and after-sales support, 10% delivery timeline, 10% relevant experience — below 70% technical compliance means no financial evaluation.
evidence: bidders scoring below 70 % on technical compliance will not proceed to financial evaluation.
